options.title: Options · {{model}}
options.noReasoning: This model exposes no configurable reasoning.
options.noParams: This model declares no other adjustable parameters.

web.label: Web search
web.help: The model can search the web and read pages. In anonymised chats the queries leave towards the search engine with the real values; fetched content comes back anonymised.
web.dockerOff: Unavailable: the browser Docker container is not running.
web.adminOff: Disabled by your administrator (Settings → LLM chat).

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.helpMandatory: Always on for this model: it cannot be turned off.
reasoning.help: The model thinks before answering: better answers on hard problems, slower and more expensive.
reasoning.effortHelp: How long to think for. The levels are the ones the model declares.
reasoning.maxTokensHelp: How many tokens the model may spend thinking. Empty = the provider's default.
reasoning.excludeHelp: The model still reasons, but the reasoning text is not returned to the chat.

param.temperatureHelp: Higher = more varied, more creative answers; 0 = the most predictable.
param.top_pHelp: Narrows the choice to the most likely words. Use instead of temperature, not alongside it.
param.top_kHelp: How many candidate words to consider at each step. 0 = no limit.
param.frequency_penaltyHelp: Positive = discourages repeating the same words.
param.presence_penaltyHelp: Positive = pushes towards introducing new topics.
param.max_tokensHelp: In tokens (~4 characters each). Empty = the model's maximum.
param.seedHelp: Same seed and same parameters = repeatable answer, where the provider supports it.
